name: chat-mattermost-go
description: Go port of the Mattermost ntfy bridge and C3 command bot (ntfy-bridge.py in chat-mattermost: bootstrap, ntfy to channel bridge, /c3 slash command, C3 bot over websocket), shadow stage: follows the ntfy stream and serves the /c3 handler read-only on its own port, holds no Mattermost credential and posts nothing, outside every request path (ticket #1880)

native_build._doc: Multi-stage: compiled in golang:1.24-bookworm on the arch-matched runner (oci-apps is arm64), shipped as one static binary on distroless static (no shell, no libc, non-root 65532, CA bundle included). Same template as infra-ops_c3bot-relay-go.

api.description: Same slash contract as the Python bridge: POST /c3 (form) and POST /c3/action (JSON button callbacks), plus GET /health. Shadow stage: read-only C3 calls, dry-run webhook.

parity-compare._doc: Reference = the original ntfy-bridge.py (user-comm_chat-mattermost/src/code, unmodified, CPython 3.11) driven through parity/ref.py against identical servers: the whole bootstrap request transcript against a stateful fake Mattermost (fresh and established scenarios), the /c3 slash and button handler over HTTP, the ntfy stream bridge and the pure helpers must be identical. See parity/parity_test.go.

_doc_shadow: Shadow stage (#1880). The live Python bridge (container mattermost-bots of chat-mattermost) is untouched. This container has no env_file and no secret: MM_BRIDGE_SHADOW=1 makes it skip every Mattermost call (no login, no channel, category, webhook, bot or icon write), refuse every non-GET C3 API call locally (so the /c3 handler on its own port cannot wake, sleep, reset, start, stop or restart anything) and turn the webhook post into a counted local no-op. It follows the same ntfy topics, so its logs show every message the live bridge also bridges. Switch-over (credentials, Mattermost bootstrap, the slash command URL pointed at this container) is a separate step after the shadow has run clean.
_doc_addressing: No mesh name, no Caddy route and no client wiring on purpose during the shadow stage: only the container itself and operators on the mesh dial 10.0.0.6:8897.
